messages:
devon: Quick thought — for the chargeback dashboard, can we add a Sankey that attributes prefetched/cache savings across routes and multi-model chains? customers keep asking "who actually benefited from the prefetch"
anya: love this. two toggles: attribution mode (marginal vs amortized) and denominator (token-weighted vs call-weighted). marginal = credit last-serving model; amortized = split by token share across chain.
sam: implementation note: telemetry currently emits "cache_hit=true" and "model_sku" per hop, but we don't carry original route id after routing. need to propagate route_id and sample_id in headers.
elaine: agree. exposing route_id to billing pipeline is sensitive for some enterprise customers — we should document opt-in. maybe add a flag on route config: `chargeback.visibility: public|private`
mike: Console UX idea: add a "simulate route slider" next to the Sankey. slide to increase/decrease route traffic and preview delta in token spend + cache savings before rollout. keep it fast by using sampled telemetry + cached per-sku unit costs.
devon: also want a canary preview mode — simulate attribution under both old and new routing policy for a subset of traffic and show projected invoice delta. that should help PMs + finance signoffs.
anya: on sampling: we should include a stable `x-rw-sample-id` header in sampled requests so we can reconstruct chains without full-trace retention. small JSON example to standardize: ```{"x-rw-sample-id": "uuid", "x-rw-origin-route": "route-123"}```
sam: note for infra — if we add `origin_route` propagation, downstream private deployments might want to scrub internal route names. add a sanitize toggle on private clusters.
elaine: gating question: do we persist per-request attribution events as raw rows or pre-aggregate? raw rows = flexible but storage heavy. pre-agg by day+route+sku = cheap but limits analysis. Thoughts?
mike: pre-agg for the default dashboard panels, raw rows behind an enterprise toggle (or retention add-on). we can also store sampling fraction to unbiasedly scale numbers.
devon: billing pipeline change: expose both `amortized_tokens` and `marginal_tokens` in the per-invocation envelope so chargeback tools can pick. keep field names explicit to avoid misinterpretation.
anya: small compliance note — when we expose `origin_route` for public dashboards, redact PII-like route names. replace with hashed aliases and show mapping only to authorized billing admins.
ops-bot: dashboard-deploy: updated sankey widget (+simulate slider) deployed to staging at `canary-12`
sam: QA request — need a unit-test harness that replays sampled traces and verifies that sum(amortized_tokens) == sum(actual_tokens) +/- sampling error. I'll prototype.
devon: one last API debate: expose a `chargeback_mode` enum on the internal route config (`none|marginal|amortized`) so we know how to attribute when prefetch happens across multiple routes. pros: makes rollout explicit. cons: extra config surface. thoughts?
anya: +1 for explicit enum, default `marginal` to preserve current accounting, and an onboarding script to migrate important routes.
elaine: ok action items: 1) sam to spike header propagation + sampling id (ETA 3d) 2) mike to prototype simulate slider UX (ETA 1w) 3) devon + anya to draft billing schema with `amortized_tokens`/`marginal_tokens` and privacy knobs (ETA 5d) 4) ops-bot to run staging canary and collect telemetry sample for the prototype.
mike: I'll add a small hovercard that shows the math: token units, unit cost, cache credits applied, and final amortized split. keep terse.
sam: FYI: potential perf risk when joining chain hops for real-time Sankey; we'll serve the Sankey from incremental aggregates and allow a drill-down that pulls sample traces for exact chains.
devon: perfect. thanks team — will summarize in a short PRD and link here. :thumbsup:
file_version_note: new thread about chargeback sankey, sampling, header propagation, simulate slider, and billing schema
